title: Great seat covers!
text: Great seat covers!. I really like these. I have been using them every Sunday since I received them for when my son and his family come to visit. My current dining room set (less than a year old) has beige seat cushions which are an open invitation for my two grandsons to make a mess during meal time. I have been using these covers for their chairs and set up and clean up is a breeze. I just throw them in the washer to clean them after use. They also look great and I just ordered another set (since I have 6 seats) to use as a means to switch up my decorating from time to time. Really highly recommend them.
